description: 63% of employers identify skill gaps in the labor market as the primary barrier to organizational transformation for 2025-2030.

instances.assertion: 63% of employers identify skill gaps in the labor market as the primary barrier to organizational transformation for 2025-2030.
Skills gaps in the labor market are identified as a top barrier to business transformation by 65% of organizations globally.

63% of organizations identify skills gaps in the labor market as a primary barrier to business transformation.
Skills gaps are identified as a primary barrier to business transformation by 19 out of 22 global industries.

Skill gaps are identified as the biggest barrier to business transformation by 63% of employers.
